doc.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Leaving Lena Horne when his mother fell ill
summary: When his mother became ill he left Lena and came home, and when his trio plans fell through he started with Jim Hall.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Okay, so you’ve now moved to New York. No, you’re still in LA.

I left Lena there. My mother became ill and I decided to come home, and as it was she lingered about seven or eight months before she passed. But when I left Lena I came back to LA and I was going to get a trio together. I was going to get Gerry Wiggins, but all these guys, man they had their own thing going so that just 86’d that. So I got myself together and got started with Jim Hall.
